baseline.message: build failed; expected binary artifact pattern 'libunwind-dev_*_arm64.deb' was not matched

error: nothing to build: the source is unchanged
rationale: The build fails when linking the test programs Lperf-simple and Gperf-trace on aarch64 because they reference the hidden GCC atomic symbol __aarch64_cas8_acq_rel, which is only available in the shared libgcc (libgcc_s). Adding -lgcc_s to LDFLAGS ensures the linker uses the shared version, exporting the needed symbol and allowing the tests (and thus the package) to build successfully on the aarch64 architecture.
